title: BHP Escondida strike 2017
description: A 44-day strike by 2,500 union workers halted the world's largest copper mine, cutting an estimated 120,000+ tonnes (~5% of global supply).

title: BHP Escondida strike 2011
description: A two-week union work stoppage at Escondida halted production at the world's biggest copper mine.

title: BHP Escondida strike 2024
description: Union workers walked off the job at Escondida after wage talks collapsed, threatening ~5% of global copper output.

title: Antofagasta drought output cut 2022
description: Chile's drought forced Antofagasta to cut 2022 copper guidance as water scarcity constrained output at Los Pelambres.

title: Codelco El Teniente collapse 2025
description: A fatal underground collapse at Codelco's El Teniente forced operations offline and cut ~48,000 tonnes from 2025 copper output.

title: Las Bambas transport-corridor blockade 2019
description: A 60-day community blockade cut ore haulage from Las Bambas, which supplies ~2% of global copper.

title: Las Bambas blockade halt 2021
description: Community road blockades forced MMG to halt operations at Las Bambas, disrupting ~2% of global copper supply.

title: Southern Copper Cuajone shutdown 2022
description: A community blockade of the reservoir and rail line suspended Southern Copper's Cuajone mine for over 50 days.

title: Antamina COVID shutdown 2020
description: Antamina suspended operations under Peru's COVID measures, cutting 2020 copper output by ~68,000 tonnes.

title: Marikana / Lonmin platinum strike
description: Police killed 34 striking miners at Lonmin's Marikana platinum operation, escalating a wildcat strike that halted output at a major PGM producer.

title: 2014 AMCU five-month platinum strike
description: An AMCU wage strike shut the Rustenburg operations of Amplats, Impala and Lonmin for five months, cutting ~40% of global platinum mine output.

title: 2008 South Africa power crisis mine shutdowns
description: Eskom told major mines it could not guarantee power, forcing platinum and gold mines to suspend operations as ~80% of world PGM supply was threatened.

title: Amplats warns Stage-6 load-shedding to cut PGM output
description: Amplats said escalated Eskom Stage-6 load-shedding would force it to curb smelting and refining, constraining PGM output.

title: Indonesia bans unprocessed ore exports 2014
description: A presidential decree banning export of unprocessed minerals took effect, halting Indonesian nickel ore exports to force domestic smelting.

title: DRC signs revised Mining Code raising royalties
description: DRC signed a revised Mining Code sharply raising royalties and enabling a strategic-substance designation, raising cobalt costs from the dominant source.

title: Glencore Katanga halts cobalt sales over uranium
description: Glencore's Katanga unit suspended cobalt hydroxide sales after detecting uranium above export limits, removing ~a quarter of world cobalt supply.

title: Glencore mothballs Mutanda world's largest cobalt mine
description: Glencore placed Mutanda, the world's largest cobalt mine (~20% of supply), on care and maintenance from end-2019.

title: Kazatomprom 20pct three-year uranium cut
description: Kazatomprom announced a 20% cut to planned output over three years from January 2018, deferring ~7.5% of global uranium supply.

title: Kazatomprom cuts 2025 uranium output on acid shortage
description: Kazatomprom lowered 2025 uranium guidance by 5,000 tU citing sulphuric-acid shortfalls and development delays.

title: Philippines orders 23 nickel-mine closures
description: DENR Secretary Lopez ordered closure of 23 mines (mostly nickel) and suspension of 5 in the world's top nickel-ore supplier.

title: Russia announces temporary grain export ban
description: Putin announced a ban on exports of wheat, barley, rye and maize after drought destroyed ~a third of the harvest, removing the #3 wheat exporter.

title: Russia announces wheat export tax and grain quota
description: Russia announced a EUR 25/tonne wheat export tax plus a 17.5 mln-tonne grain quota to non-EAEU destinations, curbing exportable supply.

title: Russia confirms floating wheat export tax
description: Russia confirmed a floating export tax on wheat, maize and barley from June 2021, structurally taxing exportable grain whenever prices rise.

title: Russia sets 2022 grain export quota
description: Resolution No. 2595 set an 11 mln-tonne non-EAEU grain export quota (8 mln wheat) effective Feb-June 2022, capping exportable supply.

title: India bans wheat exports
description: India moved wheat to the prohibited category amid heatwave-hit output and Ukraine-war supply fears, removing a major supplier.

title: India bans broken-rice exports and taxes other grades
description: India prohibited broken-rice exports and put a 20% duty on non-basmati grades after weak monsoon cut paddy acreage.

title: India bans non-basmati white rice exports
description: India moved non-basmati white rice to prohibited with immediate effect, removing ~a fifth of global rice trade.

title: Russia strikes Odesa/Chornomorsk grain ports
description: Overnight Russian missile and drone strikes on Odesa and Chornomorsk crippled grain and oil export terminals days after the grain deal collapsed.

title: Russian drones hit Izmail Danube grain port
description: Russian drone strikes on Izmail damaged silos and ~44,000t of grain and suspended Ukraine's main alternative export route.

title: Vietnam suspends new rice export contracts
description: Vietnam halted new rice export contracts to secure domestic supply during COVID, removing a top-3 rice exporter from the market.

title: Kazakhstan bans wheat flour and staple exports
description: Kazakhstan imposed a temporary export ban on wheat flour and staples, curbing supply from a major Central Asian wheat exporter.

title: Argentina raises soybean export tax to 33pct
description: Argentina raised its soybean export tax to 33% by decree, taxing exports from the world's top soymeal exporter.

title: Argentina suspends corn exports
description: Argentina suspended new corn export sales until Feb 2021, withdrawing supply from the world's #2-3 corn exporter.

title: Serbia bans wheat corn and oil exports
description: Serbia banned exports of wheat, corn and sunflower oil to protect domestic supply amid the Ukraine war.

title: Hungary bans all grain exports
description: Hungary banned all grain exports amid Ukraine-war price spikes, cutting an EU wheat/corn exporter from the market.

title: Indonesia lifts palm oil export ban
description: President Jokowi ended the palm export suspension, restoring the world's largest palm supplier and reversing a ~4-week cutoff.
